bio.text: George Latimer was born on November 22, 1953, in Mount Vernon, and his office describes him as a third-generation Westchester native.
He was elected to the Rye City Council in 1987, the Westchester County Board of Legislators in 1991, the State Assembly in 2004 and the State Senate in November 2012.
He took office as Westchester County Executive in January 2018 and was re-elected in November 2021.
He graduated from Fordham University in 1974 and earned a master's in public administration from New York University in 1976.
